_comment: Guided tour for MFD Prepare. Three steps: point at the folder, prepare, read the result. Steps carry no widget targets — the tool is a single panel, so the tour walks the workflow rather than individual controls.

steps.title: Preparation is a claim check, not a copy
steps.text:
An MFD fit reads a burst folder on trust: it assumes the channels line up, the counts agree and every measurement traces back to its photons. This tool checks those claims before a fit sits down to depend on them.

Nothing is moved or rewritten — a prepare either reports the folder is sound or names what is wrong with it.

steps.title: Choose the folder, then prepare it
steps.text:
Browse to the folder burst search wrote, then press Prepare. The service walks the folder over RPC, so a large folder keeps the window responsive.

Prepare the folder once, after burst search and before the first MFD session opens it.

await.hint: Pick a burst folder and press Prepare.

steps.title: Read all four answers
steps.text:
The result panel answers four questions: which channels were verified, whether the counts agree across companion files, where each source resolved, and what the diagnostics raised.

A channel with no photons, a count mismatch against its companions, or a source that does not resolve are all cheap to fix now and expensive to discover mid-fit.
